description: This file defines a utility object for handling interactions with the ExtendedFloatingActionButton in an Android app. It provides functions to toggle visibility, extend/shrink on long press, and show/hide based on scroll events.

classes.name: ExtendedFabUtil
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility methods to manage ExtendedFloatingActionButton behavior.

methods.name: setExtendedFabVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the ExtendedFloatingActionButton with an animation if hiding.

methods.name: toggleExtendedOnLongClick
methods.description: Sets a long-click listener to toggle the extended/shrunken state of the button.

methods.name: toggleVisibilityOnScroll
methods.description: Hides or shows the ExtendedFloatingActionButton based on scroll direction.
